method: directed-A* minimum-cost paths on 26-neighbour eroded-hull graph; no gravity blend, no streamline-then-project (route0 method, unchanged)
input: hair-hull3/hull.npz (ear-tucked carve, 479750 vox, spacing 2.0) + hair-scalp1/roots.npz (14155) + aisha_straight_long_v4.json (aisha-v3, identity registration)
erosion_rule: hull occupancy distance-transform >= 3.0 mm (2 mm grid) AND exact-SDF >= 3.0 mm

roots.rule: greedy Poisson subset, crown-first order, adaptive spacing to land 300-500 roots

ear_plane_rule: y_ear_mm = median y of scalp hairline-loop points with |x| above the 80th percentile (sideburn anchor, data-driven); root world y < y_ear -> curtain family, else back family. With the ears tucked, side hair passes BEHIND the ear: the hull itself clears the pinnae (hull3 ear gate <= 2% coverage, min clearance 2.17 mm), so minimum-cost paths through the hull pass behind/clear of the ears; measured by the new ear gate, no routing term added.
endpoint_bands: per (sector, side): curtain-L/R (root x<0 / x>=0, y<y_ear), back-L/R (root x<0 / x>=0, y>=y_ear; pools overlap +-2 mm so bundles can meet at the occiput). Pool = x-binned (10 mm bins) lowest 25 eroded voxels per bin within z <= sector_min_z + 20 mm: a hem-spanning pool derived from hull3's lowest voxels per sector. The front sector has no hair below the shoulder plane (hull3 diag (d): front 0 vox below z=1405), so the curtain pools sit at/above the shoulder line by construction; per-band zmin vs shoulder reported. Assignment is quantile-matched in lateral scalp order with hard same-sign rule, global x-monotonicity, preferred spacing 4 mm (relax 2.5 mm) over a hard distinct-voxel floor (no endpoint voxel ever shared).
part_rule: w_part * len_mm added on nodes whose x-sign opposes the root's sign (roots |x|<3 mm exempt)
edge_cost: w_len*len_mm + w_up*max(0,dz_mm) + w_curve*turn_rad + w_body*bodyterm*len_mm + w_bnd*bndterm*len_mm + w_coh*min(usage,3)*len_mm
components: routing graph = largest 26-connected component of the eroded set (sliver labels dropped at graph build; count recorded)
heuristic: weighted A* (eps=3.0) on w_len * euclidean mm
expansions_note: route0 froze 150000 on the hull0c graph; hull3's eroded graph is ~2x larger (376523 nodes) with longer thin side corridors, and a 150k run left 54/359 unreachable while acceptance-passing paths for them exist (proven by zero-usage re-search: e.g. guide 178 passes eroded-frac 0.970). The cap only truncates search, never changes the cost or the accepted paths, so 600k is a compute- budget recalibration inside the same method, not a cost change. Primary passes and retry levels unchanged.
order: scalp order (y, x) with usage-map coherence; retry passes over unreachable roots at usage scales 1.0, 0.25, 0.0; levels recorded
smooth: centripetal Catmull-Rom through path nodes, 2 mm resample; fallback = collinear-decimated voxel polyline (always inside eroded hull, SDF>=3)
accept: routed portion (arc beyond the first 8 mm) must lie inside hull occupancy with exact-SDF > 0 and arc fraction inside the eroded hull >= 0.95; root leader (first 8 mm) exempt from hull/eroded containment but exact-SDF > -1 mm
